views.ddl: CREATE VIRTUAL TABLE "1_transitive.Reach_v2" USING sqlite_ivm('WITH RECURSIVE "Reach_r2"("member", "c0", "c1") AS (SELECT 0, t0."c0_term", t0."c1_term" FROM "1_transitive.Edge_a2" AS t0 WHERE 1 UNION SELECT 0, t0."c0", t1."c1_term" FROM "Reach_r2" AS t0 JOIN "1_transitive.Edge_a2" AS t1 ON (t0."c1" = t1."c0_term") WHERE t0."member" = 0), "Reach_v2"("c0_term", "c1_term") AS (SELECT "c0", "c1" FROM "Reach_r2" WHERE "member" = 0) SELECT "c0_term", "c1_term" FROM "Reach_v2"')
